landing.heroHeadline: Your personal library, shared with friends
landing.heroSubheadline: Add your books, connect with friends, and lend your favourites — all in one place.
landing.heroTrialNote: Free for 14 days. No credit card required.
landing.featuresHeading: Everything you need for your personal library
landing.featuresSubheading: Built for book lovers who share.
landing.f_addLibrary_desc: Catalogue every book you own. Search by title or author and build your personal shelf.
landing.f_aiScan_desc: Take a photo of any cover. AI reads it and fills in title, author, category, language and description automatically.
landing.f_lendFriends_desc: Offer books to friends directly from your shelf. Track who has what and when it was lent.
landing.f_friendsShelves_desc: Browse what your friends are reading. See their full library in one combined view.
landing.f_categories_desc: Organise your library by genre. Filter by Fiction, History, Science, Politics and 17 more categories.
landing.f_multiLanguage_desc: Books in any language. Descriptions are generated in the book's own language.
landing.f_publicProfile_desc: Share your shelf with a personal link at bookshelf.name/username. Control exactly what others can see.
landing.f_mobile_desc: Add to your iPhone or Android home screen. Your library is always in your pocket.
landing.f_friendRequests_desc: Connect with people you trust. Send, accept or decline friend requests.
landing.f_loanTracking_desc: See all books you've lent and borrowed. Mark returns with one tap.
landing.f_notifications_desc: Get notified when someone sends a friend request, accepts yours, or adds a new book.
landing.f_plans_desc: Free 14-day trial. Then $1/month or $10/year. Cancel any time.
landing.howItWorksSubheading: From your first book to your first loan — everything in a few taps
landing.s_createAccount_desc: Free 14-day trial, no credit card needed
landing.s_addBooks_desc: Type the title and let AI fill in the details, or scan the cover with your camera
landing.s_organiseCategories_desc: Fiction, History, Philosophy and 19 more genres
landing.s_shareShelf_desc: Set a username and share bookshelf.name/yourname with anyone
landing.s_addFriends_desc: Search by name or invite by email
landing.s_browseShelves_desc: See every book your friends own in one place
landing.s_requestBorrow_desc: Choose how many days you need, add a message
landing.s_coordinateHandoff_desc: Lender confirms giving, borrower confirms receiving — countdown starts
landing.s_returnSmoothly_desc: Get reminders before due date, request extensions if needed, both sides confirm the return
landing.installHeading: Use it like a native app
landing.installSubheading: No App Store needed. Install BookShelf directly from your browser in seconds.
landing.installIos2: Tap the Share button (box with arrow ↑) at the bottom
landing.installIos3: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
landing.installIos4: Tap "Add" in the top right corner
landing.installIosNote: Safari only — does not work in Chrome or Firefox on iOS
landing.installAndroid2: Tap the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top right corner
landing.installAndroidNote: Works in Chrome, Edge, and most Android browsers
landing.installNote: Once installed, BookShelf works just like a native app — full screen, fast, and always available from your home screen.
landing.pricingSubheading: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.
landing.pricingMonthlyComparison: Less than a coffee a month
landing.pricingAnnualComparison: One lunch. One year of BookShelf.
landing.pricingWhyText: BookShelf is built and maintained by a small team. Your subscription covers the AI that scans book covers and generates daily reading insights, plus hosting, email delivery, and everything that keeps the platform running. No ads. No data selling. Just a fair price for a tool we use ourselves.
